sentences.en: I have time from tomorrow on.

sentences.text: Ab jetzt machen wir das so.
sentences.en: From now on we'll do it this way.
From today on, everything will get better.

sentences.text: Ab morgen geht Elke nicht mehr zur Arbeit.
sentences.en: Starting tomorrow, Elke won't go to work anymore.

sentences.text: Ab jetzt ist das mein Haus.
sentences.en: From now on this is my house.

meanings.gloss: off, away (Ab nach Hause!; particle of separable verbs like absagen 'to cancel')

sentences.en: Kids, into the car with you!

sentences.text: Mike sagte ab, er hatte keine Zeit.
sentences.en: Mike cancelled; he didn't have time.
sentences.review: 'sagte ab' is a separable-verb particle meaning 'cancel', not the adverb 'off, away' of this meaning, so it doesn't really show the gloss. The comma splice also reads abruptly; consider moving the sentence or using 'Mike sagte ab, denn er hatte keine Zeit.'

sentences.text: Ab und zu sehen wir uns noch.
sentences.en: We still see each other now and then.

sentences.text: Ab und zu kommt Ken zu mir.
sentences.en: Ken comes over to my place now and then.

sentences.text: Wir sind ab und zu in Wien.
sentences.en: We're in Vienna every now and then.
